en: Grok Bot lets you build a team of AI coworkers. Each one gets a name and a job.
zh: Grok Bot 让你组建一支 AI 同事团队，每个都有名字和分工。

en: A researcher. A writer. One that handles your money.
zh: 一个做研究，一个写东西，一个管钱。

en: They work on a cloud computer, even while your laptop is closed.
zh: 它们在云端电脑上干活，你的电脑合上了也照样干。

en: Here's the part most people miss.
zh: 大多数人没注意到的是这一点。

en: They all share that one computer. Same files. Same browser logins.
zh: 它们共用那一台电脑。同样的文件，同样的浏览器登录。

en: xAI's own docs say the screens are "separate work surfaces, not separate security boundaries."
tts: ex A I's own docs say the screens are, separate work surfaces, not separate security boundaries.
zh: xAI 自己的文档写着：分开的屏幕是“分开的工作台，不是分开的安全边界”。
sub_en: xAI's own docs say the screens are\N{\fs58}"separate work surfaces, not separate security boundaries."
sub_zh: xAI 自己的文档写着：\N分开的屏幕是“分开的工作台，不是分开的安全边界”。

en: So if you sign in to your bank for the finance bot, every other bot can use that login too.
zh: 所以你给管钱的 bot 登了银行，其他 bot 也都能用这个登录。

en: Telling a bot "don't open finance" guides it. It doesn't stop it.
tts: Telling a bot, don't open finance, guides it. It doesn't stop it.
zh: 告诉 bot“别打开财务”，只是引导它，拦不住它。

en: Only put things on that computer that every bot may use.
zh: 那台电脑上只放所有 bot 都可以用的东西。

en: If a bot needs a different level of trust, give it a separate account.
zh: 哪个 bot 需要不同的信任级别，就给它单独开一个账号。

en: And never paste a password into chat. Take control and sign in yourself.
zh: 永远别把密码贴进聊天。自己接管电脑去登录。

en: A name on the door is not a lock.
